title: Healing and Feeding of the Four Thousand by the Sea of Galilee
description: Jesus went to the Sea of Galilee and went up on a mountain. Large crowds came to him with mute, blind, paralyzed, and disabled people, and he healed them all, so that the people praised the God of Israel. After three days Jesus had compassion for the crowd, and he took seven loaves of bread and a few small fish, gave thanks, broke them, and had the disciples distribute them. All four thousand men, besides women and children, were filled, and seven full baskets of leftovers were collected. Then he got into a boat and went to the region of Magadan.
